CustomField.label: Masked names
CustomField.description: Header names, JSON keys and URL parameters whose values Replayr masks wherever it shows a request or response. Built-in names such as password and token are always masked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Names whose values this API treats as secret, separated by commas or new lines, for example customer_pin, X-Shop-Pin. Matched exactly, ignoring case. Password, token, secret, API key and similar names are always masked. Applies to JSON, form-encoded bodies, URL parameters and headers, not to XML.
